name: neo_ai

scripts.dev: tsc && doppler run -- concurrently "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on http://localhost:3001 -t 30000 && electron ."
scripts.embed:token: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), dir='dist/main'; fs.mkdirSync(dir,{recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(dir+'/.doppler-token', process.env.DOPPLER_SERVICE_TOKEN || '')"
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run embed:token && electron-builder --win --mac --linux
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run embed:token && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run embed:token && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run embed:token && electron-builder --linux

author: Zenaptic Labs
description: Blind-accessible Electron app with voice commands and magic link authentication
